name: Adela
source:
Role: Oblate 
She was the most recent oblate before I was made to leave my cell. I believe she said she was from Spain, but her mother is Italian. She hasn't said much about Catherine to me yet... she's much more interested in battle strategy. 

[Edited from the in-game description]
